command.mobsenses.status.title: Mob Senses %s on %s
command.mobsenses.status.voice.off: Voice chat: mobs do not hear it
command.mobsenses.status.voice.missing: Voice chat: on, but Simple Voice Chat is not installed
command.mobsenses.status.noise: Noise in the last minute: %s game events
command.mobsenses.status.alerted: Mobs alerted in the last minute: %s
command.mobsenses.help.title: Mob Senses commands:
command.mobsenses.help.preset: /mobsenses preset <off|subtle|default|hardcore> — how keen the senses are
command.mobsenses.help.hearing: /mobsenses hearing <0-3> — how far mobs hear, times the preset
command.mobsenses.help.sight: /mobsenses sight <0-3> — how far mobs see, times the preset
command.mobsenses.help.voice: /mobsenses voice <on|off> — whether mobs hear voice chat
command.mobsenses.help.set: /mobsenses set <option> [value] — view or change any config setting
command.mobsenses.help.get: /mobsenses get <category|option> — inspect settings by group or key
command.mobsenses.help.reset: /mobsenses reset <option|all> — restore a setting (or all) to defaults
command.mobsenses.help.debug: /mobsenses debug [on|off] — particles at noises and alerted mobs for admins
command.mobsenses.help.reload: /mobsenses reload — read the settings file again
command.mobsenses.preset.unknown: There is no preset %s. Choose one of: %s
command.mobsenses.multiplier.bad: %s does not work here: give a number from %s to %s.
command.mobsenses.voice.off: Mobs no longer hear voice chat.
command.mobsenses.voice.usage: Use /mobsenses voice on or /mobsenses voice off.
command.mobsenses.debug.on: Debug particles: on (admins see noises and alerted mobs).
command.mobsenses.debug.usage: Use /mobsenses debug on or /mobsenses debug off.
command.mobsenses.world.unknown: There is no world %s on this server.
command.mobsenses.world.inherit: World %s uses the server's preset again: %s.
command.mobsenses.hud.client_only: The Stealth HUD is client-side — run /mshud in your client chat (no OP needed) or edit config/mobsenses-client.properties.
command.mobsenses.error: Something went wrong; the details are in the server log.
command.mobsenses.status.hud_locked: Client Stealth HUD: locked by server (fair-play mode)
gui.mobsenses.title: Mob Senses
gui.mobsenses.subtitle: Acoustic Raycasting, Light Stealth, Blood Scent & Tactical HUD
gui.mobsenses.hud.locked_by_server: Stealth HUD is locked by this server (fair-play mode)
gui.mobsenses.hud.locked_by_server.tip: The server administrator disabled client Stealth HUD indicators via allow_client_hud=false.
gui.mobsenses.server.readonly.tip: You can inspect active server settings here, but changing them requires mobsenses.admin or operator rights.
gui.mobsenses.server.not_installed: Multiplayer server without Mob Senses link — showing local defaults
gui.mobsenses.hud.enabled.tip: Displays the real-time tactical stealth indicator on your screen.
gui.mobsenses.hud.style.tip: Choose between the detailed Tactical panel with sense bars or the Minimal eye icon.
gui.mobsenses.hud.layout.tip: Compact mode condenses the Tactical panel for smaller screens.
gui.mobsenses.hud.position.tip: Screen corner or hotbar anchor where the Stealth HUD is placed.
gui.mobsenses.hud.opacity.tip: Overall transparency of the Stealth HUD (10% to 100%).
gui.mobsenses.hud.offset_x.tip: Fine-tune horizontal pixel offset from the chosen anchor (-500 to 500 px).
gui.mobsenses.hud.offset_y.tip: Fine-tune vertical pixel offset from the chosen anchor (-500 to 500 px).
gui.mobsenses.hud.auto_hide.tip: Smoothly fades the HUD out when you are quiet, uninjured, and hidden.
gui.mobsenses.hud.show_range.tip: Displays your current audible radius in blocks next to the status label.
gui.mobsenses.hud.bars.tip: Toggle individual telemetry bars inside the Tactical HUD panel.
gui.mobsenses.hud.preview.tip: Forces the HUD visible for 5 seconds even if Auto-Hide is active.
gui.mobsenses.hearing.preset.tip: Overall difficulty curve scaling both mob hearing and sight.
gui.mobsenses.hearing.hearing.tip: Scales all audible sound ranges on top of the active preset (0.0× to 3.0×).
gui.mobsenses.hearing.wall_muffling.tip: Strength of sound occlusion when blocks stand between the sound and a mob.
gui.mobsenses.hearing.through_wall.tip: Whether loud sounds can still alert mobs behind solid walls after muffling.
gui.mobsenses.hearing.surface_scaling.ti: Wool dampens footsteps and landings while metal, glass, and gravel amplify them.
gui.mobsenses.hearing.gunshot_range.tip: Base range in blocks for unsuppressed firearm shots (TaCZ, Vic's Point Blank, Superb Warfare, etc.).
gui.mobsenses.hearing.gunshot_silenced_r: Base range in blocks for silenced or suppressed firearm shots.
gui.mobsenses.hearing.bullet_impact_rang: Audible radius where bullets or projectiles strike blocks, luring mobs to the impact spot.
gui.mobsenses.hearing.step_range.tip: Base walking footstep hearing range before sneaking, sprinting, or surface modifiers.
Base audible radius when mining or breaking blocks.
gui.mobsenses.hearing.door_range.tip: Base audible radius when opening or closing doors, gates, and trapdoors.
gui.mobsenses.hearing.combat_range.tip: Base audible radius of melee hits and entity damage.
gui.mobsenses.hearing.explosion_range.ti: Base audible radius of TNT, creeper, and artillery explosions.
gui.mobsenses.hearing.rain_muffling.tip: Fraction of sound masked during rainfall (0.0 to 1.0).
gui.mobsenses.hearing.feather_falling.ti: Footstep and landing noise reduction when wearing Feather Falling boots or Swift Sneak leggings (0.0 to 1.0).
gui.mobsenses.hearing.voice.tip: Allows mobs to hear players speaking over Simple Voice Chat.
gui.mobsenses.hearing.voice_range.tip: Maximum radius in blocks at which loud voice chat alerts nearby mobs.
gui.mobsenses.hearing.whisper_multiplier: Multiplier applied to voice hearing range when whispering in Simple Voice Chat.
gui.mobsenses.sight.sight.tip: Scales mob visual detection distance on top of the active preset (0.0× to 3.0×).
gui.mobsenses.sight.sight_range.tip: Base visual detection distance in blocks in full daylight.
gui.mobsenses.sight.darkness_stealth.tip: Reduces mob visual detection range when you stay in low light or pitch darkness.
gui.mobsenses.sight.min_darkness.tip: Minimum fraction of sight range preserved in total darkness (0.05 to 1.0).
gui.mobsenses.sight.torchlight_penalty.t: Holding a torch, lantern, or glowing item exposes your position from further away.
gui.mobsenses.sight.blood_scent.tip: Wounded players emit a scent trail that nearby hostile mobs can track.
gui.mobsenses.sight.blood_threshold.tip: Health fraction below which wounded players begin leaving a blood scent (5% to 100%).
gui.mobsenses.sight.blood_range.tip: Maximum distance in blocks at which hostile mobs smell a critically wounded player.
gui.mobsenses.sight.blood_particles.tip: Spawns subtle crimson drip particles when critically wounded.
gui.mobsenses.sight.investigate_speed.ti: Movement speed multiplier for mobs pathfinding toward a suspicious sound or scent.
gui.mobsenses.sight.investigate_duration: How many seconds an alerted mob searches around the last heard position.
gui.mobsenses.sight.max_alerted.tip: Caps how many mobs react to a single noise event to protect server TPS.
gui.mobsenses.sight.horde_range.tip: Distance in blocks within which an alerted mob rallies nearby allies (0 = disabled).
gui.mobsenses.sight.horde_allies.tip: Maximum number of extra allies rallied when a mob spots or hears a target.
gui.mobsenses.server.allow_client_hud.ti: When turned off, hides and locks the Stealth HUD for all connected players (hardcore fair-play).
gui.mobsenses.server.debug.tip: Shows sound wave and alerted-mob particles to server admins.
gui.mobsenses.server.stats.tip: Recent sound events processed and mobs alerted on the server.
gui.mobsenses.hearing.sound_cover.tip: Loud noises (explosions, bells, unmuffled shots) briefly mask nearby quieter footsteps and actions.
gui.mobsenses.hearing.decoy_throw.tip: Dropping items (Q) onto hard surfaces emits a distracting impact sound scaled by the item and block material.
gui.mobsenses.sight.safe_goal_filter.tip: Prevents investigating mobs from walking directly into lava, fire, campfires, or magma.
gui.mobsenses.sight.suspicion.tip: Distant single noises make mobs pause and glance toward the sound first; a second noise triggers full investigation.
How strongly solid walls attenuate blood scent detection (0.0 ignores walls, 1.0 is default, 3.0 seals scent behind walls).
gui.mobsenses.ai.ignore_bosses.tip: Excludes vanilla and tagged bosses (Wither, Ender Dragon, Elder Guardian, Warden, modded bosses) unless added to extra_listeners.
gui.mobsenses.ai.ambush_reaction.tip: When shot from outside sight range or darkness, healthy mobs sweep your direction and wounded mobs retreat instead of X-ray locking.
gui.mobsenses.ai.ambush_flee_threshold.t: Health percentage below which an ambushed mob retreats away from the shot (0% = never flee, always sweep toward the attacker).
